business_problem: Target wanted to reduce holiday shopping stress and help guests discover relevant gifts and deals faster through more personalized, conversational, and low-friction digital experiences during Cyber Monday.
solution_summary: For Cyber Monday 2025, Target deployed a multi-surface AI shopping experience across its owned commerce channels and an external conversational interface. The implementation is served through the Target app and Target.com, where the Target Deals Page highlights tailored offers and previews upcoming promotions for each shopper. In parallel, Target App in ChatGPT exposes a conversational shopping path so guests can browse and buy through an AI-led interface instead of relying only on traditional search and navigation. Target Gift Finder adds AI-driven recommendation capabilities to help users identify personalized gifts quickly, while List Scanner ingests handwritten wish lists from the mobile app and converts them into shoppable inputs. The release clearly shows the customer-facing serving and input layers, but it does not disclose the underlying models, storage systems, orchestration services, or data infrastructure behind these features.

data_flow: Guests begin in ChatGPT, the Target app, or Target.com. Conversational prompts in Target App in ChatGPT, taps in Target Gift Finder, and scans from List Scanner capture shopping intent and wish-list content. Target then returns curated gift suggestions and tailored deals through the Target Deals Page, Target app, and Target.com for browsing and purchase.
